calls.reason: Karpathy's launch-day hands-on test found Grok 3 strong on some hard tasks but failing others, such as the emoji decoding and generating tricky boards. That uneven, near-state-of-the-art picture fits a reasonable reading of 'not AGI', though the test was informal.

The January 2025 International AI Safety Report describes uneven capabilities and failures on simple reasoning. ARC Prize said even o3, which uses extra compute at answer time, was not AGI. The Sparks paper's 'early, incomplete' AGI framing falls short of broad human-level ability.
